title: The Sims Deluxe Edition PC Game 2002, EA - CIB, Very Good
descriptionText: The Sims Deluxe Edition PC Game 2002 is a complete and in box (CIB) CD-ROM featuring the popular simulation game by EA Games. It includes the game manual and is rated T-Teen. This compilation genre game offers players the opportunity to experience the challenges and joys of managing a virtual household, including relational dynamics, career progression, and personal growth. With its NTSC-U/C region code and release year of 2002, this game provides hours of entertainment for fans of The Sims franchise on the PC platform.
